## Email attachment saver
When a new email arrives (IMAP), saves its attachments to /home/node/.n8n-files/attachments/ as YYYY-MM__sender__file.

1. Add an IMAP credential (Gmail: app password, imap.gmail.com).
2. Create the folder once: `mkdir -p ~/.n8n-files/attachments` (n8n 2.x only writes inside ~/.n8n-files and won't create folders). Self-hosted n8n only; on n8n Cloud swap Save file for a Google Drive / Dropbox upload node.
3. Activate. Emails are not marked read or moved.
